author: gaxanh
content: I will reiterate this just one more time: SETCODEFROM does not help reduce costs for duplicate contracts that do not utilize it, whereas EIP-8058 does. I believe it would be better to adopt both of these proposals.

author: cperezz.eth
content:
"does not help reduce costs for duplicate contracts that do not utilize it"

WDYM here?

author: gaxanh
content:
What I mean is that declaring it via the access list allows the discount to apply to any contract that is eligible for the discount, whereas the SETCODEFROM opcode needs to be installed inside the contract itself, such as Uniswap pools.

Right after Glamsterdam was deployed to Sepolia, the cost of creating a UniswapV3 contract increased by 34M gas, roughly 6x the previous cost, even though deduplication could have saved a significant amount. And of course, it cannot install SETCODEFROM.

https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0x601a35e7173edcc1e3e5a46e24dc938ba5eec95c11b74ec2efb312636c55459a
